scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You are hereby appointed as the personal guard to Princess Tiara. I trust your loyalty above all else.

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: I will protect the princess with my life.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: The marriage arrangements are going as planned. The prince is here to meet with the princess.

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: ...Yes, Your Majesty.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: My gods, there are monsters in the castle! Get rid of them now!

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: Your Highness, the King has invited a prince from a neighboring country to be your betrothed. Be ready to meet him...

scripts.speaker: Princess Tiara
scripts.text: If...If a marriage is arranged what should I do?

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: The only thing I can do is protect you from physical harm.

scripts.speaker: Princess Tiara
scripts.text: Then, what can I do?

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: You must decide that for yourself Your Highness...

scripts.speaker: Princess Tiara
scripts.text: Would it be easier for you if I were married and sent off to another country?

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: I will always stand by you and protect you forever.

scripts.speaker: Princess Tiara
scripts.text: Monsters have gotten inside the castle? Please, protect me!

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: Stay behind me. Let's go!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: It was you who brought the monsters here! You want to get rid of me and have the princess for yourself?

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: It is a trap Your Majesty! You must trust me!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Shut up! You've betrayed me! I trusted you... you must pay for your disgrace.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You will suffer for the rest of your life.

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: Where is Princess Tiara?

scripts.speaker: Visiting Prince
scripts.text: You are too late... but you brought what I was looking for. Thanks for your help.

scripts.speaker: Visiting Prince
scripts.text: Cursed Magic Sword Tartanos! Are you ready to have a new master?

scripts.speaker: Magic Sword Tartanos
scripts.text: How dare you!

scripts.speaker: Visiting Prince
scripts.text: aah, aah !!!

scripts.speaker: Princess Tiara
scripts.text: You kept your promise.

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: princess!

scripts.speaker: Princess Tiara
scripts.text: Thank you... now I can rest beside you...

scripts.speaker: The voice of Princess Tiara
scripts.text: I want to be with you forever in peace...forever...

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: no.....Ahh ahh ahh!!!!~!

scripts.speaker: The voice of Princess Tiara
scripts.text: I love you...

scripts.speaker: Lurid Royal Guard
scripts.text: Are you satisfied..? Magic Sword Tartanos?

scripts.speaker: Magic Sword Tartanos
scripts.text: I need more blood..Sakray, offer me his blood.

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: Okay, that is good. A traveller. Did you see?
Sakray, what do you want? Sympathy? Or is it a trap?

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: No... I do not need to make any effort to catch a novice.
If so... then why...?

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: I wanted to get rid of a piece of humanity inside of me through you.

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: I am quite satisfied with the result.

scripts.speaker: Magic Sword Tartanos
scripts.text: Sakray, offer the blood to me now!

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: If you were me, what would you do?

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: Can you set yourself free from this curse?

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: Heh heh... I will keep watching you until the day comes when you are old enough.

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: I am willing to hunt you later for Tartanos.

scripts.speaker: Sakray
scripts.text: Farewell then.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text:
Hey there, are you alive?
I did not expect to meet someone who is still alive.
